statement: A physical DS4 reference's actual force feedback strength, player LED lightbar response and pass/fail of USB/BT output formats is not experimentally measured by C/D or B historical virtual-host runs.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: Consumer source reports expected bytes and the older virtualgamepad tests do not compare against actual DS4.
